title: Senior Graphic Designer
description:
About the Company

**Digital Matrix Innovations is a creative content and marketing agency** based in Jail Road, Tilak Nagar, New Delhi.

We work with brands across social media, branding, content, performance marketing, creative campaigns, advertising, video, and digital growth.

We are building a team of **creators, designers, strategists, and creative thinkers, not just employees who complete assigned tasks**.

We want people who have strong technical skills, but also strong **visual taste, creative judgement, curiosity, and ownership**.

As the company grows, we want the people working with us to grow with it, creatively, professionally, and financially.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a **Senior Graphic Designer** who can create visually strong, thoughtful, and brand\-led design work across multiple clients and categories.

This role is not just about knowing Photoshop or Illustrator.

We are looking for someone who understands **why a design works,**  typography, hierarchy, colour, spacing, composition, brand tonality, visual storytelling, and overall creative direction.

You should be able to take a basic brief and turn it into something that feels polished, intentional, and visually strong.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Create high\-quality **social media creatives, ad creatives, campaign visuals, branding assets, presentations, brochures, website graphics, and marketing collateral**.
* Develop **logo concepts, brand identities, visual systems, typography directions, and brand guidelines**.
* Translate creative briefs and campaign ideas into strong visual concepts.
* Work across multiple brands with different visual styles and tonalities.
* Maintain consistency in typography, colours, layout, imagery, and overall brand language.
* Create visual directions and moodboards for new campaigns and brands.
* Work closely with **creative strategists, content strategists, video editors, social media managers, performance marketers, and creators**.
* Review and improve design output before it is presented to clients.
* Guide junior designers and provide creative feedback when required.
* Handle multiple client projects, deadlines, and revisions simultaneously.
* Adapt designs for different digital formats, ad sizes, social platforms, and print requirements.
* Contribute ideas during brainstorming and campaign planning sessions.

**Creative Expectations**

We are specifically looking for someone with **strong visual taste and design maturity**.

You should understand:

* Typography and font pairing
* Visual hierarchy
* Colour theory
* Composition and balance
* Grid systems
* Negative space
* Brand tonality
* Image treatment
* Product presentation
* Shadow, lighting, and depth
* Editorial\-style layouts
* Social media and advertising design
* Logo and identity design

The final design should be able to **communicate the idea without needing a long explanation**.

**Creator Mindset**

We want someone who thinks like a **creator and visual storyteller**, not only a production designer.

You should:

* Actively follow design trends, brands, campaigns, fashion, culture, and visual references.
* Regularly study good design and understand why it works.
* Bring references and ideas to the table.
* Be comfortable challenging weak visual directions and suggesting better ones.
* Experiment with new tools, AI\-assisted workflows, and creative techniques.
* Understand how design should adapt across different platforms and audiences.
* Care about the final output, not just completing the task.

**Required Skills**

* Strong hands\-on knowledge of **Adobe Photoshop**.
* Strong hands\-on knowledge of **Adobe Illustrator**.
* Strong understanding of **typography, font pairing, spacing, hierarchy, composition, colour, and branding**.
* Good experience in **logo design and brand identity development**.
* Strong understanding of social media and advertising creatives.
* Working knowledge of **Figma**.
* Good knowledge of **Canva**, especially for collaborative social media workflows.
* Knowledge of **Adobe InDesign** will be preferred.
* Basic knowledge of **After Effects, motion graphics, or video editing** will be an advantage.
* Knowledge of **3D tools, Blender, Cinema 4D, or similar software** will be an additional advantage.
* Familiarity with AI creative tools such as **Adobe Firefly, Midjourney, ChatGPT, or similar platforms** will be useful.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain consistency across multiple assets.

**Experience**

* **3–5 years of relevant professional graphic design experience**.
* Experience in a **creative, advertising, digital, or marketing agency** will be strongly preferred.
* Candidates should have experience handling **multiple brands simultaneously**.
* Strong experience in **branding, social media, campaigns, typography, and visual communication** is preferred.

**Portfolio Requirement**

A strong portfolio is **mandatory**.

We would especially like to see:

* Logo design
* Brand identity projects
* Social media campaigns
* Advertising creatives
* Typography\-led work
* Campaign key visuals
* Presentation or editorial design
* Packaging or print design
* Website/digital design
* Any motion graphics or 3D work, if applicable

Candidates should be able to explain **what they personally contributed to each project**.

**Job Details**

* **Position:** Senior Graphic Designer
* **Company:** Digital Matrix Innovations
* **Location:** Jail Road, Tilak Nagar, New Delhi
* **Work Mode:** Work from Office
* **Working Days:** Monday to Saturday
* **Working Hours:** 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM
* **Employment Type:** Full\-time
* **Experience:** 3–5 years
* **Joining:** Immediate or short notice period preferred

**Who This Role Is For**

We are not looking for someone who simply knows design software or creates template\-based posts.

We want someone who can look at a brand and think:

* What should this brand visually feel like?
* Is the typography right?
* Does the layout have enough breathing room?
* Is the hierarchy clear?
* Does this feel premium, youthful, bold, corporate, or luxury as intended?
* Does the creative look like it belongs to this brand?
* Can this visual become part of a larger campaign or identity?

We are looking for a designer with **strong taste, creative judgement, ownership, and the ability to turn ideas into visually memorable work**.

Pay: ₹40,000\.00 \- ₹55,000\.00 per month

* How many years of professional experience do you have in graphic design, branding, or visual communication?
* Please share your portfolio / Behance / Drive link and 3–5 projects you consider your strongest.
* Which tools do you use hands\-on? Please mention your proficiency in Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, Figma, Canva, InDesign, After Effects, or any other relevant tools.
* Have you worked on logo design, complete brand identity systems, typography\-led design, social media campaigns, ad creatives, or campaign key visuals? Please briefly mention the type of projects you have handled.

* Apart from graphic design, do you have any additional creative skills such as motion graphics, video editing, animation, 3D design, UI/UX, photography, or AI\-assisted creative workflows?

* What is your notice period / earliest joining date?

* Do you have your own laptop that you can bring to the office and use for work, if required?
* Are you comfortable working from office at Jail Road, Tilak Nagar, Monday to Saturday, 10 AM–6 PM?
* If shortlisted, are you comfortable completing a practical branding and social media design assessment as part of the selection process?

title: Senior Interior Designer
description:
**Senior Interior Designer \-** **New Delhi, India**
**Design the Places Where People Love to Be Together**
At Populous, we design the places where people love to be together. From stadiums and arenas to entertainment destinations, airports and major civic spaces, our projects are about much more than buildings. They are about creating experiences, and the interiors of those spaces play an important role in how people connect with them.
We’re looking for a talented **Senior Interior Designer** to join our New Delhi studio and become part of our broader APAC interiors and design team. This is an opportunity for a Senior Interior Designer who enjoys thinking beyond individual spaces, someone interested in how interiors, architecture, materiality, movement and experience come together to create memorable places.
You’ll work alongside architects, designers and specialists on major projects in New Delhi, across India and throughout the APAC region, helping take ideas from early concepts and storytelling through to documentation and delivery, leading Interior Design packages and projects.
**About Populous**
Populous is a global architecture and design practice specialising in places that draw people together. For more than 40 years, we have designed some of the world’s most recognised sports and entertainment venues, arenas, convention and exhibition centres, airports, mixed\-use destinations and major public spaces.
Our work starts with people. We think about how a place feels, how people move through it, what they experience when they arrive and the moments they remember when they leave.
Our New Delhi studio is part of a connected APAC practice, giving our people the opportunity to contribute to significant projects locally while collaborating with colleagues and specialists across the region and around the world.
**What you’ll be doing**
As a Senior Interior Designer at Populous, you’ll contribute across different stages of the design process, bringing creativity, technical capability and a strong understanding of the user experience to our projects.
You’ll have the opportunity to:
* Develop and Lead interior design concepts working closely with the APAC Interior Design Lead, in collaboration with architects, designers and multidisciplinary project teams.
* Interpret project briefs and translate ideas into thoughtful, engaging interior environments.
* Lead Interior Design teams and packages through conception to delivery.
* Explore materiality, finishes, furniture, lighting and spatial experiences as part of an integrated design response.
* Develop compelling presentations, narratives and visual material that communicate design ideas to clients and stakeholders.
* Lead the production and coordination of interior design documentation using Revit, ensuring alignment with project standards, technical requirements, and delivery objectives, while providing guidance and oversight to project team members.
* Work closely with architectural teams to ensure interiors are integrated into the broader project vision.
* Coordinate with consultants, suppliers and manufacturers to develop and deliver design outcomes.
* Bring an understanding of the Indian market, products, materials and suppliers to project teams.
* Contribute ideas, curiosity and a strong design perspective to our New Delhi studio and wider APAC interiors community.

**What we’re looking for**
We’re interested in designers who are creative thinkers as well as capable project managers– people who can develop an idea, communicate it clearly and help turn it into reality.
Ideally, you’ll bring:
* **10\-15 years**’ experience in interior design, ideally within an architecture, interiors or multidisciplinary design practice.
* A bachelor’s degree in interior design, Interior Architecture, Architecture or a related discipline. Postgraduate qualifications and relevant professional certifications/ accreditations would be advantageous.
* Strong design capability and an ability to develop concepts with a clear narrative and point of view.
* Experience leading teams and packages through delivery.
* Experience contributing to the design and delivery of complex interior projects. Experience across sports, entertainment, hospitality, aviation, cultural, commercial or other large\-scale public environments would be highly regarded.
* Strong Revit capability and an understanding of design documentation and coordination.
* An eye for materials, finishes, furniture and emerging interior design trends.
* Extensive knowledge of the local market, including materials, products, brands, manufacturers, and vendor networks, with the ability to guide product selection, develop robust specifications, and ensure design solutions are aligned with project quality, budget, and delivery objectives.
* Strong visual communication, sketching and presentation skills.
* The ability to communicate design concepts and technical details clearly with clients, consultants and project teams.
* Confidence working both independently and collaboratively within multidisciplinary teams.
* Strong attention to detail and a practical approach to problem solving.
* The ability to balance creativity with the technical and commercial realities of delivering major projects.
* Curiosity, initiative and a willingness to contribute ideas.

Most importantly, we’re looking for someone who genuinely enjoys design and collaboration and wants to help create places that people remember.
**Why Populous?**
There are architecture and design practices, and then there are opportunities to help shape places experienced by thousands, sometimes millions, of people.
At Populous, you can build your career while contributing to projects with genuine public impact.
Our New Delhi team is connected to a global network of designers and specialists, creating opportunities to learn from different disciplines, collaborate across borders and build experience across sectors and project types.
Our people also have access to benefits including:
* Flexible and hybrid working arrangements with one day per week working from home.
* Professional development and learning opportunities.
* Career development through leadership programs, mentoring, CPD and technical knowledge\-sharing.
* Enhanced paid leave provisions, including parental, study, community service, blood donation, fertility and adoption leave.
* Holistic Employee Assistance Program (EAP).
* Opportunities to collaborate across our global practice.
* Social, community, and volunteering initiatives.
* Regular studio events, design chats, and opportunities to connect with colleagues across the APAC region.

We want our people to have the support, opportunities and experiences they need to build meaningful careers.
**Interested?**
We know a great Senior Interior Designer is more than a list of software skills or years of experience. We’re looking for someone who cares about the details, is curious about how people experience spaces, enjoys working with others and gets excited by the opportunity to see an idea move from sketch to built environment.
If that sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive.
**Send us your CV and portfolio and come help us design the places that bring people together.**

description:

---------------


Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.


Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers.


Atlys is changing that.


We’re building an AI\-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we’ve processed visas for **1M\+ travellers across 127 countries**. But we’re still early.

  

**The Role**
------------


We're looking for a **Motion Designer** to own motion and interaction design across the Atlys app and website.


You'll work with Product Designers, PMs and Engineers to make Atlys feel intuitive, responsive and premium.


This is a high\-ownership role. You'll own motion from concept to final QA, making Atlys feel like a product designed to move rather than one with animations added afterward.

  

**The Job**
-----------

* **Bring product experiences to life.** Turn static Figma designs into full interactions, including transitions, micro\-interactions, gestures, and loading, success and error states.
* **Simplify complex flows.** Use motion to make visa applications, status changes and payments easier to understand, starting early in each feature.
* **Own the Atlys Motion Library.** Build reusable patterns, motion principles and haptics guidelines that give Atlys a consistent motion language.
* **Partner with Engineering to ship it right.** Write specs engineers can build, choose the right format (native, CSS, Lottie or video) and keep animations lightweight.
* **Own product storytelling.** Lead motion for product videos, launches and landing pages that show Atlys' value quickly.

  

**The Ideal Candidate**
-----------------------


You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

* Have 3–5 years of motion or interaction design experience in a tech company or similarly fast\-moving digital product environment.
* Have a strong portfolio of product UI motion (not just marketing or brand animation) that shows how motion improves usability and communicates state.
* Are highly proficient in Figma and at least one motion or prototyping tool (After Effects, Rive, ProtoPie, Jitter), have hands\-on experience with Lottie, and understand web and native (iOS/Android) constraints.
* Can build and maintain a motion system, and document it so designers and engineers actually use it.
* Communicate motion decisions clearly, push back when motion can fundamentally improve the UX, and spot opportunities without waiting to be asked.

*We hire exceptional people for their craft, not travel enthusiasts. We solve hard problems that happen to touch global travel and government infrastructure.*

  

**What you can expect**
-----------------------


Atlys is built by a small team with outsized ambition, high ownership, and an obsession with doing great work.


Here’s what you can expect:

* **Competitive compensation and equity** so you participate in the value you help create.
* **Comprehensive health insurance** covering you and your family, plus annual preventive health check\-up on us.
* **A thoughtful leave policy** with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off.
* **Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office**, so the basics are taken care of while we build together.
* **Learning \& development credits** to invest in courses, books, conferences and tools that help you get better at your craft.
* **Relocation support** to make moving closer to the team as seamless as possible.
* **Great tools to do your best work**, including high\-spec equipment and software.
* **An office designed for more than just work**, with pickleball, table tennis, PlayStation, an arcade game room, an F1 simulator and even a full flight simulator.

  

Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you’ll probably thrive here. If it doesn’t, it’s better to know that upfront.

**About the Role**

We are hiring a **Communication Designer** for a leading design\-led architecture practice.  

This role sits at the intersection of **architecture, storytelling, visual communication, and brand consistency**.  

The studio’s work needs to be communicated to different audiences — clients, students, media, design juries, institutions, and collaborators. Each audience reads architecture differently. A client looks for value and trust. A student looks for process. A media platform looks for narrative. A design jury looks for intent, clarity, and rigour.  

That is why this role is best suited for someone who has studied or deeply understands architecture, but may not want to practise core architecture.  



**Why an Architecture Background Helps**  

This is not a typical graphic design role.  

  

You will work with:


* plans, sections, drawings, diagrams, renders, photographs, and project notes
* Architectural concepts, material stories, context, process, and spatial intent
* Project decks, award entries, website features, presentations, and design narratives
  


 To do this well, you need to understand what architects are trying to say before turning it into clear visual communication.  

A B.Arch background is valuable because the role requires someone who can read design intent, not just arrange text and images.


**What You Will Do**


* Create visual communication assets for presentations, website, social media, print, events, and digital platforms
* Support project features, award entries, pitch decks, and design presentations
* Translate architectural ideas into clear visual formats
* Work with principals and design teams to understand project intent
* Develop layouts using strong grid, typography, image treatment, and hierarchy
* Help maintain consistency across the studio’s communication material
* Support communication for talks, school presentations, project launches, and media features
* Work with drawings, renders, site images, process notes, and project stories


**What We Are Looking For**  

You may be a strong fit if you:


* Have a B.Arch or architecture / spatial design background
* Enjoy communication more than conventional architectural practice
* Can understand architectural drawings and design process
* Have strong visual layout and typography sense
* Are comfortable working with both images and text
